 About Sören Storks
 CountryGermany
 Recorded matches57
 Available seasons2022/2023 – 2026/2027
 Competitions5
 Sören Storks is a German referee born on November 9, 1988 in Velen, Germany. At 36 years old, he has had a remarkable career in German football refereeing. In addition to his work on the field, he also works as a carpenter He began his refereeing career in 2013 in the German 3. Liga and, after proving his worth, was promoted to the 2. Bundesliga in 2015. In 2017, he made the leap to the Bundesliga, the top tier of German football. One of the most notable matches he officiated was the Bundesliga match between FC Augsburg and Mainz 05 on September 20, 2024. In this match, which ended in a 3-2 victory for Mainz, Storks showed a total of seven yellow cards and two red cards, highlighting his firmness in disciplinary management. Throughout his career, he has been involved in high-profile games in the Bundesliga and other German competitions, establishing himself as a respected referee in German football.
